text:
Priya Nandakumar: heads-up: support ticket reporting surprise billing on mixed-dim payloads. customer wants a preview of cost in Console before they hit send
Sam Ortiz: makes sense. could be a client-side estimator or we ask clients to send a cheap hint header so Console can show immediate numbers
Ethan Wu: agree with both. client estimator = nice UX but we need an official header that SDKs can set so Console and server telemetry align
Maya Singh: proposal: optional `X-Embed-Units-Estimate` header + `X-Embed-Dim-Hint`. Header format: `units=12;method=client-js-1`
Priya Nandakumar: love simple format. important: header must be advisory. server may split and produce a different unit count
Sam Ortiz: please define how clients compute units. We should provide canonical formula in SDKs: units = non_zero_dims * per_dim + ceil(bytes / 1024) * per_kb + sparse_flag * 0.25
Ethan Wu: watch out: per_dim varies by model. SDK should include model_id in estimate calculation or use model-agnostic baseline. otherwise big drift
Maya Singh: server response will include `X-Embed-Server-Estimate: units=14;reason=split(2);model=embed-large-v2` when it differs. Console will show both numbers and a short explanation if delta > 10%
console-bot: suggestion: show green check if estimates match within 10%, amber if 10-30%, red if >30% with link to "why estimates differ"
Priya Nandakumar: telemetry: log client_estimate, server_estimate, final_billed_units, and split_count as tags. aggregate by SDK version and route. alert if median delta by SDK version > 25% over 1h
Sam Ortiz: implementation notes: SDKs (JS/Python/Go) add computeEmbedEstimate(inputs, opts). Console should run computeEmbedEstimate on sample payloads in the browser for preview. If header present, Console trusts client estimate as well for instant UX, but still displays server value when response arrives
Ethan Wu: edge cases: 1) very sparse vectors where non-zero count << dims; 2) mixed dense/sparse batches; 3) compressed payloads (gzip) where bytes vs perceived size diverge. For (1) we expose `sparse_nonzero` hint header so estimator can be accurate
Maya Singh: we also need good error messaging: if server splits and returns 413 with split plan, Console should surface "Large request — try sample split" with a one-click convert-to-async workflow
Priya Nandakumar: rollout: opt-in header + Console preview for 1% of orgs for two days, then 10% for a week, collect telemetry, then GA. Docs: add "Estimator reference" and example code for SDKs
Sam Ortiz: test matrix: parity tests between SDK estimator and server estimator; fuzzed inputs (random dims, zeros, huge byte arrays); integration test that Console overlay updates after response headers
Ethan Wu: security note: headers are non-sensitive and rate-limited. do not log raw inputs in telemetry, only counts and hashes. add PII filter for any strings in payloads
Maya Singh: OK I'll draft the spec PR: header syntax, example responses, console UX variants, telemetry schema. tagging @Priya for rollout plan and @Ethan for runtime behavior
Priya Nandakumar: perfect. I'll open a follow-up thread with the sample SDK snippet and telemetry field list later today :+1:
